summary: Created and opened `desk:apps:temp`; it converts Celsius to Fahrenheit and shows `F: ?` for invalid input. Verified that `25` displays `77`.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
give {text: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
set t to s.text
when k is 'backspace'
set t to edit_text(s.text, k)
otherwise
when count(k) is 1 and ('.-0123456789' has k)
set t to s.text & k
done
done
give {text: t}
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s.text)
when is_number(s.text)
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & text(number(s.text) * 9 / 5 + 32))
otherwise
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
give nothing()
done
